metadata_caption: Her “30k” cup at the end! 😂❤️ backstory ::: Ever since I brought Kay home a turkey sandwich without knowing that she couldn’t eat it during pregnancy, I have told my self that the first thing I was going to do for Kay after she had Elliott! After she was born, and everything settled down, I snuck away to the nearest sub place and got Kay’s coveted turkey sub! 😂 I can only imagine how bad she’s wanted to have that for the last several months! I am so glad that she’s finally able to eat these again, as we used to go on sub-dates all the time, and it’ll be nice to do that again! ❤️ #kayandtayofficial #couples #relationships #postpartum
